echo DEVICE: $(grep DEVICE_ID /etc/routermgmt/agent.conf | cut -d= -f2)
echo === 1/5 隧道修复 ===
cp /etc/routermgmt/tunnel.conf /etc/routermgmt/tunnel.conf.bak
sed -i 's/^VPS_HOST=.*/VPS_HOST=134.175.151.213/' /etc/routermgmt/tunnel.conf
sed -i 's/^VPS_PORT=.*/VPS_PORT=28722/' /etc/routermgmt/tunnel.conf
sed -i 's/154\.36\.137\.54/154\.36\.139\.155/g' /etc/routermgmt/tunnel.conf
sed -i 's/154\.36\.137\.54/154\.36\.139\.155/g' /etc/mihomo/config.yaml
echo === 2/5 respawn 根因修复 ===
sed -i 's/respawn 3600 5 5/respawn 3600 0 0/' /etc/init.d/routermgmt 2>/dev/null
sed -i 's/respawn 3600 5 5/respawn 3600 0 0/' /etc/init.d/mgmt-tunnel 2>/dev/null
grep respawn /etc/init.d/routermgmt | head -1
echo === 3/5 self-heal 部署 ===
echo  | openssl base64 -d -A > /etc/routermgmt/self-heal.sh
chmod 755 /etc/routermgmt/self-heal.sh
sh -n /etc/routermgmt/self-heal.sh && echo SELF_HEAL_SYNTAX_OK
grep -q self-heal /etc/crontabs/root 2>/dev/null || echo '* * * * * /etc/routermgmt/self-heal.sh #self-heal' >> /etc/crontabs/root
echo === 4/5 fw3 include ===
uci show firewall | grep -q mihomo-ipt || {
uci add firewall include >/dev/null
uci set firewall.@include[-1].type=script
uci set firewall.@include[-1].path=/etc/mihomo-ipt.sh
uci set firewall.@include[-1].reload=1
uci commit firewall
}
echo === 5/5 重启验证 ===
/etc/init.d/mgmt-tunnel restart
sleep 10
echo HEALTH: $(curl -sk -m 6 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://127.0.0.1:18443/api/v1/health)
/etc/init.d/mihomo restart
sleep 8
echo EGRESS: $(curl -s -m 12 -x http://127.0.0.1:7890 https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null || echo FAIL)
/etc/init.d/routermgmt restart
sleep 5
echo AGENT: $(ps w | grep -c [r]outermgmt-agent)
echo CRON: $(crontab -l | grep -c self-heal)
echo ALL_DONE
